# Ali Mohsen Maruf

> Personal portfolio of Ali Mohsen Maruf, a student, researcher, and builder in Bangladesh. His work spans digital products, design, teaching, and spatial research.

## About

Ali studies Geography and Environment at Jahangirnagar University. He explores different interests through research, digital products, design, and teaching. He is currently building AmarApply, a scholarship information and discovery platform.

## Selected work

- [AmarApply](https://scholarships.amarapply.com): Scholarship information and discovery platform.
- [Jahangirnagar University land cover assessment](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alimohsenmaruf_gis-qgis-spatialanalysis-activity-7510648950807314432-EwSI): Preliminary QGIS and OpenStreetMap based spatial assessment.
